name: Marie Byrd Land
#why: Marie Byrd Land, the unclaimed sector between the Ross Dependency and the Chilean claim, as a country card (requested 2026-10-03 by Jens Nordmark (@nordmarj): "add Marie Byrd Land"; New Swabia not). Derived by a rule, never by a name: Antarctica's land as its own card draws it, less every Official claim polygon of Natural Earth's claims layer, which draws no unclaimed polygon. What is left is the land between 90 W and 150 W, the mainland sector and the 29 islands off it (Thurston, Siple, Carney ...): 1,482,675 km2 measured 2026-10-04 on EPSG:3031, against the 1,610,000 km2 English Wikipedia gives the unclaimed territory including Eights Coast. Natural Earth draws Queen Maud Land to the pole, so nothing is left south of Norway's claim. Two zero-area slivers on 44 38' E, where Queen Maud Land and the Australian Antarctic Territory meet, are seams, not land, and are dropped (pieces under 1 km2; the smallest real island is 19 km2). The point 120 W 80 S must lie in the land the rule leaves; it checks the result and selects nothing. The name is no dataset's: notes.tsv holds the adjudicated one.

Rockall's land is one polygon of Overture's base land, id 401e1211-27ec-3dfa-ac05-61d0fb7b0575, a land row of class islet (added as a card 2026-10-04 at the request of Jens Nordmark (@nordmarj): "yes, add Rockall as a card"). Natural Earth draws Rockall only as part of the United Kingdom (admin-0 GBR, admin-1 GB-ELS) and GADM not at all. Found 2026-10-04 by reading every base land row of Overture release 2026-08-19.0 within 0.05 deg of 57.5958 N 13.6875 W, the coordinates English Wikipedia gives: eight rows, three sharing one outline (rock/bare_rock, land/land and this land/islet row, the one Overture names the islet by), with Hasselwood Rock's and Helen's Reef's reef polygons, two points and the archipelago multipolygon of Na h-Eileanan Siar. The islet is one polygon of 37 vertices, 558 m2 (English Wikipedia: 784.3 m2). The polygon must cover the point 13.68738 W 57.59631 N, or the row is refused: the data moved under it. Its sovereign's card is GBR, whose own Rockall, as Natural Earth draws it, every other card keeps.

Rockall's sea is a 12-nautical-mile territorial sea and no exclusive economic zone (ruled 2026-10-04 by Jens Nordmark (@nordmarj)): Rockall cannot sustain human habitation, so under UNCLOS art. 121(3) it has a territorial sea and no EEZ, and the United Kingdom has claimed none from it since acceding in 1997. For an isolated rock the territorial sea is the band of that breadth around it, so the card's own waters are its land buffered by 12 nautical miles, measured on a projection centred on the land and tinted as a zone would be, on this card only.

Peter I Island's land is Overture's base land polygon f3439f65-1e03-3837-a202-1240d4a790ec, not Natural Earth's (requested 2026-10-11 by Jens Nordmark (@nordmarj): "fix Peter I"). Natural Earth's Antarctica draws the island as a polygon of 43.45 km2 whose centroid lies 8.6 km north of the island's, overlapping it by 16.4 km2, and fails it on extent; the island is 154-156 km2 (English Wikipedia; Wikidata's 243 km2 is wrong). Overture draws it as one polygon of 159.86 km2, 13.3 x 18.8 km, 1,256 vertices (measured geodesically 2026-10-11). Two rows of release 2026-08-19.0 share the outline: this one, land/island with names.primary 'Peter 1s øy', and 99203b2b-1b0f-3266-aff6-389af1680050, land/land, unnamed, one vertex more and no area of difference; the island row is taken, as Rockall's islet row was. The polygon must cover the point 90.6 W 68.8 S and overlap Natural Earth's island, or the row is refused: the data moved under it. Only the claim card's land changes: its code, claimant and framing stay, Antarctica's card and every other card keep Natural Earth's island.

Isla Serranilla (Beacon Cay), one of Serranilla Bank's four cays: Overture base land islet 7fd501e2-5d66-3206-9139-2a4d06856e15, 126,995 m2 measured 2026-10-17, which must cover the point 79.84594 W 15.79589 N or the row is refused. Serranilla's land is Overture's cays, not Natural Earth's speck of 0.04 km2 some 15 km west of the bank (ruled 2026-10-17 by Jens Nordmark (@nordmarj)); picked by id, never by a name, the islet row and not its unnamed land/land twin.

No other dataset draws it. Exactly one polygon with NE_ID 1159104605 and WIKIDATAID Q16896007 must cover the point 0, 0, or the row is refused. Natural Earth's countries layer gives B19 to Morocco, all of it inside MAR's row, which draws it as held. Joined with B28: 269,524 km2 against the published 266,000 (+1.3%, Wikidata Q6250 P2046), chosen over the World Bank's outline (270,260 km2, 2,502 km2 of symmetric difference) because both pieces share Natural Earth's base with their neighbours. The polygon with BRK_A3 B19 must cover Laayoune, 13.2033 W 27.1536 N, or the row is refused.

Natural Earth's countries layer draws only this piece, 90,900 km2, as ESH. Joined with B19: 269,524 km2 against the published 266,000 (+1.3%, Wikidata Q6250 P2046). The polygon with BRK_A3 B28 must cover Tifariti, 10.6167 W 26.0928 N, or the row is refused.

The Baikonur Cosmodrome, leased to Russia until 2050, is a card of its own (KAB) and is also drawn inside Kazakhstan (ruled 2026-09-21 by Jens Nordmark (@nordmarj)): a lease is a card like Guantanamo's, but the leased ground is still Kazakhstan's, and folding it out left a white hole in the middle of the country. Natural Earth's row reaches Kazakhstan through its ISO_A3_EH; the lessor is named here so it does not rest on that column.

The Guantanamo Bay Naval Base, leased to the United States since 1903, is a card of its own (USG) and is also drawn inside Cuba (ruled 2026-09-21 by Jens Nordmark (@nordmarj)), as Baikonur is inside Kazakhstan. Natural Earth cuts it out of Cuba's polygon, a 65 km2 notch drawn as neutral land, though its status reads territory of Cuba; GADM agrees at level 1, its Guantanamo province covering 95% of the base. Natural Earth's row has no ISO code at all, so the lessor is named here.

name: Svalbard and Jan Mayen
#why: Svalbard and Jan Mayen's card takes Natural Earth's Jan Mayen (NJM) as well as Svalbard: ISO 3166-1 defines SJM as "Svalbard and Jan Mayen", and Marine Regions agrees, both maritime zones carrying ISO_TER1 SJM, while Natural Earth gives Svalbard the SJM code and files Jan Mayen under Norway. Taking the land from one and the waters from the other drew a detached tinted zone 950 km away holding an island drawn as foreign. This reconciles the two datasets on codes; it is not a fix for one region.

Gaza, drawn from GADM, kept beside Palestine's 16 governorates, which are ISO 3166-2's only tier and are drawn from geoBoundaries' second level (ruled 2026-11-16 by Jens Nordmark (@nordmarj)). Gaza is one of GADM's two first-level units of Palestine and a card under this code and GUID since before the entity register. Under the rule that a governed unit off the tier a country is drawn at takes a third level and is drawn without the subdivisions inside it (ruled 2026-11-16 by Jens Nordmark (@nordmarj)), its only sibling is the West Bank, with no governorate line.

The West Bank, drawn from GADM, kept beside Palestine's 16 governorates, which are ISO 3166-2's only tier and are drawn from geoBoundaries' second level (ruled 2026-11-16 by Jens Nordmark (@nordmarj)). The West Bank is one of GADM's two first-level units of Palestine and a card under this code and GUID since before the entity register.
